input.quote: Any and all disputes between the parties that cannot be settled by mutual agreement shall be resolved solely and exclusively in the state or federal courts located within San Luis Obispo County, California, and each party consents to the jurisdiction of such courts and irrevocably waives any objections thereto
input.rationale: California law with exclusive jurisdiction of California state/federal courts and no arbitration sits at our accepted fallback. We note only that the venue is TrueLink's home county (Client is in Orange County) — a point we could raise commercially, but not a playbook deviation.

input.quote: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
input.rationale: Consent is required for any assignment with only an affiliate carve-out — there is no successor/M&A carve-out and no reasonableness standard, so it fails the fallback and would let TrueLink block a sale of our business. We added the M&A/successor carve-out on notice and a "not unreasonably withheld" standard; helpfully, there is no vendor change-of-control termination right to delete.

input.quote: Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 8(d) hands TrueLink an unrestricted right to distribute, license, resell and exploit data originating with our borrowers, and the agreement nowhere confirms Client's retained ownership of its data and IP — directionally adverse under this rule. TrueLink keeping ownership of the Interface (Section 2(d)) is acceptable; we narrowed the Credit Data licence to service delivery and added a Client ownership/no-joint-ownership sentence.

input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The grant runs to Client alone: affiliates are not covered and there is no mechanism to add them, which fails the fallback even though the licence is not revocable at will (it runs with the term). We inserted affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf into the grant; successor transferability is addressed under ASSIGN rather than duplicated here.
